# CASE-002 — Seed data in repository fixtures

Sentinel flagged hundreds of name/email/date-of-birth records in `fixtures/` of an application repository.

**Facts:** Records carried `TST-` IDs and `example.test` emails; file consumed by the integration test suite; git history shows it was generated by the TestForge CLI.

**Rationale:** Synthetic-test-data pattern, all signals present. Fixture data in a test folder is the intended use of TestForge output.
